senses.gloss: BOUGIE: मूत्रमार्गादेर्मलशोधनाय यन्त्रविशेषः; *प्रवेशिका
BOULDER: गण्डशैलः (?), Ki. vii. 37.
BOULEVARD: राजपथः: v. Street.

BOUNCE:
I To spring: q. v.: आस्कन्दी
(स्कन्द्, c. 1).
II To boast: q. v.
BOUNCING: v. Stout, strong.

BOUND (subs.):
I A leap, spring: q. v. []
लम्फः।
II Limit, confine, boundary: q. v.:
Ph. without b. v. Boundless;
to keep within
b. s
सीमां न व्यत्येति (इ, c. 2);
to transgress the
b. s of decorum
मर्यादां भिनत्ति (भिद्, c. 7).

BOUND (v. t.): Ph.:
b. ed on the north by the
Himālayas
यस्योत्तरसीमा हिमालयः; b. ed on the
all sides (i. e. encircled) by the river Vetravatī
वेत्रवत्या परिगतः (ता, तं);
b. this field
अस्य क्षेत्रस्य
 सीमां निर्धारय (धृ, c. 10).
BOUND (v. i.): v. To leap, spring.

BOUND (adj.)
I Confine: बद्धः (द्धा, द्धं): v.
To bind.
II Destined: Ph. b. for Puri
पुरीयात्रिन् (f. णी);
where are you b. to
क्व गच्छसि।
III Equiv. to must: q. v.:
you are b. to do
this
त्वयेदमवश्यं कर्तव्यम्।

BOUNDARY: सीमा (f.)
or
सीमन् (m.):
a dispute
about b. s
सीमाविवादः;
on the b. lines
सीमा-
सन्धिषु;
b. marks
सीमालिङ्गानि, M. viii. 6.
248. 249.

BOUNDLESS:
(1) असीमः (मा, मं);
(2) निरवधि
(mfn.) (rare),
b. ditch
निरवधिपरिखा, Vi. vi.

BOUNTEOUS BOUNTEOUSLY: v. Bountiful,
bountifully.

BOUNTIFUL:
(1) वदान्यः (न्या, न्यं): v. Muni-
-ficent;
(2) उदारः (रा, रं): v. Liberal.

BOUNTIFULLY:
to give b.
मुक्तहस्तं ददाति: v.
Liberally, largely.

BOUNTIFULNESS:
(1) वदान्यता;
(2) औदार्यम्: v.
Liberality, generosity.

BOUNTY:
I Munificence: q. v.: वदान्यता।
II Gift: q. v. दानम्।
III A premium or
reward: q. v.: पारितोषिकम्।

BOUQUET:
I Of flowers: v. Nosegay.
II
Of wine: आमोदः।

BOURGEON: स्फुटति (स्फुट्, c. 6): v. To bud,
sprout.
BOURN: v. Bound, limit.

BOUT:
I A conflict, contest: q. v.
II A
turn: q. v. वारः।
